sections.title: Reconstruction after property damage in Princeton checks the subfloor support

sections.title: Install the finish to the room boundary
paragraphs: The floor material is measured, cut and installed to the manufacturer's requirements over the prepared base. We will fit transition pieces at adjoining floor heights and reset base trim included in the scope, keeping the edge detail clear in the estimate.

sections.title: Choose how far the replacement should continue
paragraphs: An exact match may not exist for an older floor. We will explain whether a natural break can define the repair or whether extending the material across a larger area is an option. That choice sets the visible seam and quantity of materials.
